_STATUS: T0 boot scaffold (Step B1, 2026-09-09). memory.blocks/fighter_fields/globals are ALL PLACEHOLDERS (0x0 / empty): no live RAM address is known yet, mirroring src/profile.rs's own minimum-boot fixture, not a real memory map. This is a SINGLE-ACTOR game — blocks.block2/stride will remain stubs even after RE (the schema mandates them); player fields land in memory.globals, not fighter_fields, so Lua reads them via game.addr(). gate is intentionally EMPTY: training and the recorder refuse to run against it, and gate::eval_gate reads an empty gate as CLOSED (not vacuously open) — the honest T0 state, replaced by real conditions after the RE step. enforcement/calibration carry dummy schema-satisfying values only (unmeasured). memory.cpu='6502' overrides the schema default 'm68k' so the Sek 68k register capture can never treat this as a 68k game; endianness='little' overrides the default 'big' (NES). core.provenance_core is the Step-B2 measured decision; see tcsurfdesign.md's Core capability section.
